text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't go around thinking there's a field 
of flowers waiting beyond my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't really think that— but "reality" 
really is one hell of a wasteland, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: You can still keep going, right?
You can still keep going, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: You can still keep going, right?
You can still keep going, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'd rather throw up blood than 
throw in the towel. Give me some brutal 
training!"
choice_data_list: V-Vomiting blood is a bit much for me...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It was just a figure of speech. 
I'll leave the specifics to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Just train, train, and train some more...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'm gonna plow right through 
this wasteland of 'reality' with my own 
horseshoes!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, of course I'm fine. Do I look like 
the type to break down cryin' to you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"For better or worse, I've got the spirit 
of a weed. I'm not a flower that breaks 
when stepped on."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll sprout anywhere, even in a wasteland!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
From now on, don't hold back at all— train 
me into shape, good and hard!
